Other attributes like studytime, failures, absences, goout, Dalc, Walc, health, famrel, freetime, internet, romantic, etc., could be measured via questionnaires at end of year or throughout. However, for prediction of final grade, we want to predict at some point before final grade known. Usually you could predict after first period (using G1) or after second period (using G2).
